opportunities.observation: The selected routed experts require many more weight values than the router or elementwise stages.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Analytical Kimi K3 decode model before trace calibration.
competing_explanations: Batch reuse may reduce weight traffic.
Expert weights may already be resident near compute.
Routing imbalance may increase or decrease useful reuse.
opportunities.mechanism: Place expert compute near expert weight storage and schedule tokens by expert.
opportunities.falsifier: Measured traces show expert weight movement below ten percent of critical-path time.
opportunities.next_measurement: Capture selected expert IDs and HBM bytes for representative decode batches.

opportunities.observation: KDA replaces context-growing cache with fixed recurrent state, but that state is read and written for every token.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Exact state geometry with analytical traffic and one reduced KV260 head measurement.
competing_explanations: The full state cannot fit on chip for useful batch sizes.
State traffic may overlap with expert compute.
A lower-precision state may reduce traffic without quality loss.
opportunities.mechanism: Bank recurrent state near a fused KDA update engine.
opportunities.falsifier: Capacity or bandwidth makes local state slower or less efficient than a generic memory path.
opportunities.next_measurement: Compare local and streamed state RTL with matched arithmetic on the KV260.

opportunities.observation: The current KDA FPGA core uses one-dimensional row lanes and does not prove that this is the best compute shape.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Measured 8-lane KV260 core plus uncalibrated tile proxy.
competing_explanations: A two-dimensional tile may improve compute use.
Tile setup and banking may remove the benefit at batch one.
opportunities.mechanism: Use a resource-matched two-dimensional tile for projections and recurrent updates.
opportunities.falsifier: Post-route cycles, timing, or memory conflicts do not improve over the row-lane design.
opportunities.next_measurement: Implement a small exact-arithmetic tiled RTL candidate.
